goal: Extract credential and profile component configuration from BaseClient to reduce its implementation size and group related state and configuration methods.

ops.details: Move the credentialsExtractor, authenticator, and profileCreator fields and their related getter, setter, and default-initialization methods into BaseClientProfileConfiguration. Keep compatible forwarding methods in BaseClient for existing callers. Update retrieveCredentials(org.pac4j.core.context.WebContext, org.pac4j.core.context.session.SessionStore, org.pac4j.core.profile.factory.ProfileManagerFactory), retrieveUserProfile(org.pac4j.core.credentials.Credentials, org.pac4j.core.context.WebContext, org.pac4j.core.context.session.SessionStore), getUserProfile(org.pac4j.core.credentials.Credentials, org.pac4j.core.context.WebContext, org.pac4j.core.context.session.SessionStore), and toString() to access the extracted configuration.
